landing.reviews_rev1_text: I postponed updating my portfolio for months. With Portfolium, I connected my GitHub and within 2 minutes exported a clean static site to GitHub Pages. Already got 3 interview requests complimenting the aesthetics.
landing.reviews_rev2_text: The GitHub README generator with automatic manifest detection (package.json, Cargo.toml) transformed my profile. Surreal speed, completely in the browser without asking for credentials.
landing.reviews_rev3_text: As a hiring manager, most portfolios I receive are sluggish and broken on mobile. The pure HTML generated by Portfolium scores 100 on performance and the ATS format passes directly through our screening bots.
landing.reviews_rev4_text: The visual presets (especially AMOLED and the Orbital layout) rival top global design agencies. None of the usual generic or amateur templates.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Welcome to Portfolium. By using our platform, you agree to the following terms.
terms.sec1_desc: Portfolium is open source software licensed under the MIT License. You are free to inspect, run locally, and contribute.
terms.sec2_desc: You are solely responsible for the information, images, repositories, and copy inputted or imported into your portfolio session.
terms.sec3_desc: The service is provided 'as is', without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including downtime of third-party services like GitHub.
terms.sec4_desc: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time to reflect technical or legal improvements.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is paramount. Portfolium was engineered from day one with the Local-First principle.
privacy.sec1_desc: We operate no central database and collect zero personal data on our servers. All modifications are saved exclusively within your device local storage.
privacy.sec2_desc: When importing public repositories, requests are dispatched directly from your browser to GitHub's official API. Your tokens are never stored or intercepted by us.
privacy.sec3_desc: We do not use third-party advertising cookies or cross-site tracking. Local storage is strictly used to persist your selected theme, language, and portfolio drafts.
privacy.sec4_desc: Because your data resides on your machine, you maintain complete sovereignty: export anytime via .json or erase completely by clearing browser storage or using our Cookie Manager.

about.title: About Portfolium
about.mission_desc: Building a standout professional presence should not require hours configuring web stacks or paying monthly fees to closed platforms. Portfolium empowers tech professionals with speed, autonomy, and aesthetic excellence.
about.pillar1_desc: No forced sign-ups, no vendor lock-in. The data belongs strictly to its creator.
about.pillar2_desc: Write Once, Run Anywhere with Expo SDK 57, React Native 0.86, and React 19 across Web, Desktop, and Mobile.
about.pillar3_desc: Refined typography, immersive theme support (Lava, AMOLED, Dark), and buttery GPU motion.
